newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system via overnight system repurchase agreements on Wednesday, a central bank spokeswoman confirmed.
The Fed could begin the new two-week maintainence period on Thursday with five-day fixed system RPs, which would cover the Memorial Day holiday weekend, analysts said.
With the need for reserves growing in coming weeks, analysts said a permanent injection of reserves could come as early as Wednesday, via an outright purchase of bills or, less likely, a coupon pass.
However, the timing is hard to predict and analysts said a pass may not come until early June.
The federal funds rate was trading at 5-9/16 percent, above its 5-1/2 percent target, when the Fed performed its open market operation.
